comment: Recognition layer: downtown prominence signposts. These Kingston schools are NOT on the V1 route but are prominent institutions that get a road-sign HUD callout when the route passes closest to them. See GAME_SPEC.md: 'road signs / map callouts pointing downtown, narrator may name-check them'. All entries marked needs_owner_review: true — trigger_road is a best guess from map research; owner's lived knowledge is authoritative for exact placement.

signposts.label: Kingston College (KC)  •  St. George's  •  Kingston Technical  •  Wolmer's Boys & Girls
signposts.note: trigger_road is a best guess — Hagley Park Road is the route segment nearest Wolmer's Boys/Girls (Arthur Wint Drive area). KC, St. George's, and Kingston Technical are further east (downtown/Cross Roads area) and may warrant a separate signpost triggered earlier on Mountain View Avenue or Windward Road. Owner please advise exact trigger placement and whether to split into two signposts.
